name: Panther Mastery
summary: At Nesingwary's Expedition, Sir S. J. Erlgadin sets one final trial for you. You have hunted panthers before, but the expedition's party has failed to find Bhag'thera. Bring back the predator's fang to prove your skill as a master of the hunt.

sections.title: The Elusive Prowler
sections.body: At Nesingwary's Expedition, Sir S. J. Erlgadin sets one last test for you. Bhag'thera still prowls Stranglethorn Vale, beyond the expedition's party's reach. Track down the great panther and bring back its fang as proof of your skill.

faq.answer: Sir S. J. Erlgadin offers this hunt at Nesingwary's Expedition in northern Stranglethorn Vale.
You are hunting Bhag'thera, a great panther that prowls the jungle and has eluded the expedition's party.
Sir S. J. Erlgadin requires the Fang of Bhag'thera as proof that you defeated the beast.
This hunt follows the third trial in the Panther Mastery line and builds on your earlier panther hunts.
